1use super::GameEnv;
2use crate::db::{AbilitySpec, CardId};
3use crate::effects::EffectSpec;
4use crate::state::CardInstanceId;
5
6pub(in crate::env) struct LiveAbilityRef<'a> {
7    pub spec: &'a AbilitySpec,
8    pub effects: &'a [EffectSpec],
9    pub grant_id: Option<u64>,
10}
11
12impl GameEnv {
13    pub(in crate::env) fn prune_granted_abilities(&mut self) {
14        self.state.turn.granted_abilities.retain(|grant| {
15            if grant.expires_turn_number < self.state.turn.turn_number {
16                return false;
17            }
18            let p = grant.target_player as usize;
19            let s = grant.target_slot as usize;
20            self.state
21                .players
22                .get(p)
23                .and_then(|player| player.stage.get(s))
24                .and_then(|slot| slot.card)
25                .map(|card| card.instance_id == grant.target_instance_id)
26                .unwrap_or(false)
27        });
28    }
29
30    pub(in crate::env) fn remove_granted_abilities_for_stage_instance(
31        &mut self,
32        player: u8,
33        slot: u8,
34        instance_id: CardInstanceId,
35    ) {
36        self.state.turn.granted_abilities.retain(|grant| {
37            !(grant.target_player == player
38                && grant.target_slot == slot
39                && grant.target_instance_id == instance_id)
40        });
41    }
42
43    pub(in crate::env) fn live_stage_ability_at<'a>(
44        &'a self,
45        player: u8,
46        slot: u8,
47        ability_index: usize,
48    ) -> Option<LiveAbilityRef<'a>> {
49        let p = player as usize;
50        let s = slot as usize;
51        let card_inst = self.state.players.get(p)?.stage.get(s)?.card?;
52        let card_id: CardId = card_inst.id;
53
54        let static_specs = self.db.iter_card_abilities_in_canonical_order(card_id);
55        if ability_index < static_specs.len() {
56            let spec = static_specs.get(ability_index)?;
57            let effects = self.db.compiled_effects_for_ability(card_id, ability_index);
58            return Some(LiveAbilityRef {
59                spec,
60                effects,
61                grant_id: None,
62            });
63        }
64
65        let mut remaining = ability_index.saturating_sub(static_specs.len());
66        for grant in &self.state.turn.granted_abilities {
67            if grant.target_player != player
68                || grant.target_slot != slot
69                || grant.target_instance_id != card_inst.instance_id
70            {
71                continue;
72            }
73            if remaining == 0 {
74                return Some(LiveAbilityRef {
75                    spec: &grant.spec,
76                    effects: grant.compiled_effects.as_slice(),
77                    grant_id: Some(grant.grant_id),
78                });
79            }
80            remaining = remaining.saturating_sub(1);
81        }
82        None
83    }
84
85    pub(in crate::env) fn live_stage_ability_count(&self, player: u8, slot: u8) -> usize {
86        let p = player as usize;
87        let s = slot as usize;
88        let Some(card_inst) = self
89            .state
90            .players
91            .get(p)
92            .and_then(|state| state.stage.get(s))
93            .and_then(|slot_state| slot_state.card)
94        else {
95            return 0;
96        };
97        let static_count = self
98            .db
99            .iter_card_abilities_in_canonical_order(card_inst.id)
100            .len();
101        let granted_count = self
102            .state
103            .turn
104            .granted_abilities
105            .iter()
106            .filter(|grant| {
107                grant.target_player == player
108                    && grant.target_slot == slot
109                    && grant.target_instance_id == card_inst.instance_id
110            })
111            .count();
112        static_count + granted_count
113    }
114}
